# PetriMed CA

> > PetriMed CA is an Indian air purification company specializing in HEPA-filtered air purifiers, bipolar ionizers, and air quality monitors for residential and automotive applications.

PetriMed CA offers advanced air purification solutions including the APS 400 and APS 20 systems with H-14 HEPA filtration technology, targeting India's indoor air quality challenges. The company provides comprehensive product information, technical documentation, and customer support resources.

## Key Topics

- HEPA Filtration
- Air Purification Systems
- PM2.5 Pollution

- Bipolar Air Ionizer

## Core Products

- [Product Catalog - Air Purifiers, Ionizers & Quality Monitors](https://petrimedca.com/products): Complete product lineup featuring APS air purification systems, AI-100 bipolar ionizer, and AQM-10 air quality monitor
- [APS 400 Air Purification System](https://petrimedca.com/product/aps-400-air-purification-system): Premium home air purifier with H-14 HEPA filter specifications, CADR ratings, and customer reviews
- [APS 20 Car Air Purification System](https://petrimedca.com/product/aps-20-petrimedca-car-air-purification-system): Automotive air purifier with ionizer technology, pricing, and vehicle compatibility details
